title: Cosmic Eye Snow Globe
description: A metallic snow globe sits on a wooden surface, its glass sphere containing a glowing pink central eye emitting yellow lightning bolts over a detailed nighttime cityscape with bridges and skyscrapers. Outside the globe, a large purple cosmic eye and two menacing spiky demonic faces with sharp teeth float against a starry purple nebula background.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a metallic snow globe on a wooden table. Inside the transparent sphere is a glowing pink eye on a stand shooting bright yellow lightning bolts across a futuristic city skyline at night with illuminated bridges over water. Outside the globe floats a large purple cosmic eye with a black pupil and two menacing pink and red demonic spiky faces with sharp teeth and evil grins. Stars and purple nebula fill the dark background, dramatic lighting, vibrant colors.
